messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — we need a pragmatic plan for the first post-launch iteration. Customers are surfacing 3 high-severity bugs on the hotpath and ~5 request-for-enhancements. How do we balance?
Rohit Patel: Agree we should triage by user-impact + reproducibility. Propose: P0 (blocks core flow), P1 (major UX/regression), P2 (nice-to-have).
Eli Gomez: Data: the hotpath error rate spiked to 2.4% for returned tokens > 1024. That corresponds to ~8% of active sessions last 24h. Feels like P0/P1 territory.
Jun Park: Two paying customers (ACME & BlinkHealth) asked for a prompt-structure tweak that would reduce token usage ~20% — that's an enhancement but directly tied to their bill.
Casey Liu: Can we run a short canary for the prompt tweak? If it's low-risk we can ship as a canary alongside bug fixes. :thinking_face:
Maya Chen: Suggested sprint split: 55% bug fixes (focus on hotpath P0s), 25% customer-driven low-risk enhancements (canary first), 20% backlog grooming / tech debt. Thoughts?
Rohit Patel: Sounds reasonable. Need an acceptance checklist for P0s: reproduction steps, failing CI test, rollback plan, postmortem owner. If any item missing, escalate to oncall.
Eli Gomez: Add metrics guardrails: pre/post canary latency & error delta thresholds. Example thresholds: latency +5% allowed, error delta <= 0.2pp (otherwise rollback).
Jun Park: For ACME and BlinkHealth, I'll scope the prompt tweak and produce a short rollout plan by EOD. Will include a minimal A/B config.
Casey Liu: ops-bot: create a canary release for branch `hotpath-prompt-tweak` targeting 2% traffic and 2 customer orgs.
ops-bot: Canary release created: branch=hotpath-prompt-tweak, target=2%, orgs=[ACME,BlinkHealth], canary_id=canary-1787.
Maya Chen: Thanks. Owners: Rohit -> bug triage + fixes; Jun -> customer prompt enhancements & rollout; Eli -> metrics & canary guardrails; Casey -> release ops.
Rohit Patel: I'll start setting up the bug board and tag todos with owners + estimated hours. If we need to reallocate mid-sprint, call a quick sync. :thumbsup:
Eli Gomez: I'll add dashboard tiles: hotpath error rate, median latency @p50/p95, canary vs prod diff. Also wire an alert if error delta > 0.2pp.
Jun Park: FYI — ACME asked for delivery within 2 weeks. I'll confirm feasibility after scoping.
Casey Liu: If ACME needs faster SLA we can prioritize their enhancement but will need product sign-off on scope cut vs regressions.
Maya Chen: Final decision for sprint planning meeting: commit to 55/25/20 split unless ACME signs urgent request that pushes to 40/35/25. We'll reconvene tomorrow 10:30am. Please drop quick estimates before 6pm.
Rohit Patel: Estimates incoming.
Eli Gomez: Quick note for follow-up: capture a short runbook for each P0 so oncall can triage without context.
Jun Park: Acknowledged — will include runbook in the customer enhancement PRs.
Casey Liu: Adding release checklist items now.
Maya Chen: Great work — small, measurable steps. :rocket:
